# hbctl

> Fast, agent-friendly Rust CLI client for remote Homebox v0.26+ REST APIs.

## Docs

- [README](docs/README.md): Overview, installation, usage, configuration
- [Config Example](assets/config.example.toml): Annotated TOML configuration options
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): Architecture, module map, and quality gates

## Source

- [src/cli.rs](src/cli.rs): CLI flags and subcommands
- [src/config.rs](src/config.rs): Layered configuration precedence
- [src/client/mod.rs](src/client/mod.rs): Homebox v0.26+ REST client
- [src/dedup.rs](src/dedup.rs): Two-pass deduplication engine
- [src/output.rs](src/output.rs): Table, compact JSON, plain, CSV, Markdown renderers
